sources.title: Alexander Pedals Princess Clang - Royal Overdrive | Effects Database
sources.h1: Alexander Pedals Princess Clang - Royal Overdrive
sources.excerpt: Effects Database describes the 2015 Princess Clang as a limited production of thirty pieces worldwide and a tweaked version of a pedal Alexander Pedals built in 2002.

sources.title: Alexander Pedals Launches Princess Clang Overdrive - Premier Guitar
sources.h1: Alexander Pedals Releases the Princess Clang Royal Overdrive
sources.excerpt: Premier Guitar's October 5, 2015 report says the Princess Clang was limited to 31 units worldwide. It describes the 2002 lineage, the added two-band tone stack and active midrange Contour, and increased gain and output, with coverage from clean boost through overdrive and distortion.

sources.title: Princess Clang Manual - Alexander Pedals
sources.h1: Wrap your tone in the resplendent robes of royalty
sources.excerpt: The manufacturer manual documents Level, Drive, Bass/Treble and Contour controls, true-bypass soft-touch switching, settings memory, 2015 production limited to thirty pieces, and 9-18V DC center-negative operation with no battery.

next_action: Use this evidence to write the canonical research record; preserve the documented 30-versus-31 unit discrepancy as source-attributed evidence rather than forcing a single count, and do not infer unsupported component/version claims.
